# eDrops

> eDrops is a 20L water jar delivery app for customers in India.

## What eDrops does

eDrops lets customers order 20-litre packaged drinking water jars online. Customers can:

- Place a one-time order or subscribe to recurring deliveries
- Top up a prepaid wallet (UPI, card, net banking) — no cash at the door
- Get doorstep jar swap: delivery partner brings full jars and takes empties
- Pause, skip, or reschedule deliveries anytime from their dashboard
- Track orders live and view delivery history

## Who it's for

- Households ordering 20L water jars for home use
- Offices, cafes, clinics, and workplaces ordering in bulk with volume pricing

## Where it operates

eDrops currently delivers in Kondotty and Malappuram, Kerala, India. Expansion to more areas is ongoing.
